description: OligoBackMod aims to develop oligonucleotide therapeutics with enhanced nuclease resistance and improved pharmacokinetic properties through novel backbone modifications.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Principal Investigator at University of Basel

funding_summary: The project is funded by the European Research Council (ERC) under the Horizon Europe program, with a contribution of €150,000.
inflection_why_now: The increasing prevalence of diseases previously unaddressable by conventional therapies creates a pressing need for innovative treatments like oligonucleotide-based drugs.
devils_advocate_risks: Challenges in scaling up the chemical modifications for oligonucleotide synthesis.
Regulatory hurdles in obtaining approval for new therapeutic modalities.
